nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What are the consequences of the deterioration of this symbiosis during marine heatwaves?
nodes.answer: The deterioration often results in corals rapidly expelling their symbionts, which can induce mortality unless the symbiosis is restored.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Ocean acidification|Ocean acidification and coral disease_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What can cause dysbiosis in the coral symbiotic system?
nodes.answer: The accumulation of temperature and irradiance stress can lead to symbionts overproducing harmful photosynthetic by-products, driving the system toward dysbiosis.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Ocean acidification|Ocean acidification and coral disease_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How were the corals prepared before being placed in the incubation chambers?
nodes.answer: The corals were gently rinsed with 0.2 m FSW to remove any potential symbionts adhered to the tissue surface.
